stage: V2.2B Team Aggregation and Team AI Report

migration.requiredDryRun: exactly this one migration; no include-all/repair/ledger writes

scoring.deployedPolicy: pending_stage_5/1/1 with empty configuration; weighted effective 0..4 numeric questions normalized to 100; weighted positive-weight blocks; cutoffs 30/50/70/85
scoring.implementation: PostgreSQL numeric per-participant CTE followed by avg/stddev_pop/min/max. No participant score table or worker score payload.
scoring.reproducibility: immutable private scoring snapshot; fail closed on unsupported policy/config or inconsistent maturity/questionnaire; current questionnaires never rewritten

privacy.threshold: >=3 valid completed non-revoked responses, enforced by SQL APIs and table RLS
privacy.source: SHA256 of canonical jsonb team/version/snapshot hash/sorted participant id, revision, completed_at; only digest public
privacy.qualitative: private answers -> DB masking -> per-question independently shuffled lists with >=3 texts -> confidential synthesis -> strict schema plus DB leakage validator -> main report
privacy.publicationGuard: checks every participant name/email, UUID/email/phone/URL patterns, every 32-character raw text substring; rejected content is never persisted or logged

architecture.jobs: private.team_jobs with unique(kind,team,fingerprint), SKIP LOCKED claims, leases, max attempts, source recheck and transactional publication. One bounded team job after each legacy worker iteration.
architecture.concurrency: team row first for all submissions/invitation mutations/close/report/worker writes, then participant/response/job; completion survives queue failure, owner refresh recovers
architecture.reports: immutable completed versions, company context snapshot per version; source mismatch is stale; below threshold all report reads hidden
architecture.safeAI: separate TEAM_AI_PROVIDER default mock, explicit openai opt-in only; no real AI acceptance authorized
architecture.rollout: one additive migration, pinned CLI 2.117.0 --skip-vault, exact dry-run only new file, preserve all old migration bytes, worker Live before mock report acceptance
